metrics.final_message:
The `todos` library is written and both `hd check --tests` and `hd test` pass (12 tests, 0 failures).

- **`src/todos.hd`** holds the public API: `Todo`, `TodoError`, `load`, `dump`, `complete` and `pending`, plus the unit tests in a `tests:` block.
- **`src/lib.hd`** re-exports those items. `hd new --lib` makes `src/lib.hd` the library root, so the public names are re-exported from `todos` there.
- **`tests/todos.hd`** is an integration test that uses the public API through `pkg`.
- **`hd.toml`** was created by `hd new --lib --vcs none .` in the current directory, so there is no git repository.

Design choices:
- `load` uses `decode::[List[Todo]]` with derived `Deserialize`, and maps any decode error to `BadJson` with the JSON error text as the message. `done` has a default of `false`, so it can be absent.
- `Todo` derives `Serialize`, `Deserialize`, `Arbitrary`, `Eq` and `Debug`. `dump` is `encode`, so `load` reads its output back unchanged. A property test checks this on generated todo lists.
- `TodoError` has `@error` messages and derives `Eq` and `Debug`.
- `complete` returns `UnknownId` when no todo has the id. If several todos share the id, all of them are marked done.

The tests cover a missing `done`, the empty array, and several invalid inputs (non-array, missing `id` or `title`, fractional or out-of-range `id`, non-bool `done`, `null` `done`, a numeric `title`, and malformed text). `hd fmt` reformatted the files, then `hd lint` reported nothing, and `hd check --tes
